title: Archive Newsreel — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Context card
scenes.purpose: Intertitle establishes the reel and subject
visuals: Dark intertitle card with double rule on a cool silver-stock projected plate between perforated film edges

beats.development: Card copy resolves in 0.25 s then holds for reading
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

scenes.title: Framed action
scenes.purpose: Hard splice to the event: the idea sparks and links reach five stations
visuals: Framed screen with bulb and five stations
Accent-blue travelling pulses draw each link; stations light on arrival

beats.development: Splice flash and cut; the bulb sparks with rays
Eight links draw outward and across; five stations light in turn

scenes.title: Evidence caption
scenes.purpose: Concise evidence line over the settled network
visuals: Solid dark caption bar with its text cut in together

beats.development: Caption appears by 2.37 s and holds; frame fully settled
captions: One spark lit — five stations now on the line.

findings: Card, cut, event and evidence line follow the Archive Newsreel characteristic action inside 3 s

notes: No preview recipes were supplied (empty list); preview demonstrates the base characteristic action
